items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...article in one of them about Elmer Fajn's group... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, he was a leader...

ctx.x: When I was at Paul Howard's house, his wife brought out some old newspapers and entertainment journals

and there was an article in one of them about Elmer Fajn's group. It had some name -- the Jolly Jesters or something like that. And they'd been in some kind of a dispute with a club owner who hadn't paid them or something. It was a news article.
